NUMBER_OF_REQUESTS.label: Number of Requests
NUMBER_OF_REQUESTS.description: Total count of HTTP requests in the browsing session.

TOTAL_DURATION.label: Total Duration
TOTAL_DURATION.description: Total session duration between first and last request.

AVERAGE_TIME.label: Average Inter-arrival Time
AVERAGE_TIME.description: Mean time elapsed between consecutive requests.

STANDARD_DEVIATION.label: Inter-arrival Std. Dev.
STANDARD_DEVIATION.description: Standard deviation of intervals between requests (variance in pacing).

REPEATED_REQUESTS.label: Repeated Requests Ratio
REPEATED_REQUESTS.description: Fraction of requests to URLs that were already requested earlier.

HTTP_RESPONSE_2XX.label: HTTP 2xx Success Ratio
HTTP_RESPONSE_2XX.description: Proportion of requests returning 2xx status codes (e.g. 200 OK).

HTTP_RESPONSE_3XX.label: HTTP 3xx Redirection Ratio
HTTP_RESPONSE_3XX.description: Proportion of requests returning 3xx redirect status codes.

HTTP_RESPONSE_4XX.label: HTTP 4xx Client Error Ratio
HTTP_RESPONSE_4XX.description: Proportion of requests returning 4xx error status codes (e.g. 404).

HTTP_RESPONSE_5XX.label: HTTP 5xx Server Error Ratio
HTTP_RESPONSE_5XX.description: Proportion of requests returning 5xx server error codes.

GET_METHOD.label: GET Method Ratio
GET_METHOD.description: Proportion of HTTP requests using the GET method.

POST_METHOD.label: POST Method Ratio
POST_METHOD.description: Proportion of HTTP requests using the POST method.

HEAD_METHOD.label: HEAD Method Ratio
HEAD_METHOD.description: Proportion of HTTP requests using the HEAD method.

OTHER_METHOD.label: Other HTTP Method Ratio
OTHER_METHOD.description: Proportion of requests using other methods (PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS).

NIGHT.label: Night Traffic Ratio
NIGHT.description: Proportion of requests occurring during off-hours (00:00 to 06:00).

IMAGES.label: Images Resource Ratio
IMAGES.description: Proportion of requests requesting image assets (.png, .jpg, .ico).

TOTAL_HTML.label: HTML / Page Ratio
TOTAL_HTML.description: Proportion of requests requesting HTML documents or root pages.

HTML_TO_IMAGE.label: HTML-to-Image Ratio
HTML_TO_IMAGE.description: Ratio of HTML requests to image asset requests.

HTML_TO_CSS.label: HTML-to-CSS Ratio
HTML_TO_CSS.description: Ratio of HTML requests to CSS stylesheet requests.

HTML_TO_JS.label: HTML-to-JS Ratio
HTML_TO_JS.description: Ratio of HTML requests to JavaScript script requests.

WIDTH.label: Session Breadth (Width)
WIDTH.description: Number of distinct, unique URLs visited during the session.

DEPTH.label: Average Path Depth
DEPTH.description: Mean directory hierarchy depth (slashes in URL paths).

STD_DEPTH.label: Path Depth Std. Dev.
STD_DEPTH.description: Standard deviation of URL directory path depth across requests.

CONSECUTIVE.label: Consecutive Repeat Ratio
CONSECUTIVE.description: Proportion of back-to-back requests targeting the exact same URL.

DATA.label: Total Data Transferred
DATA.description: Total bytes returned by the web server across all requests.

SF_REFERRER.label: Referrer Present Ratio
SF_REFERRER.description: Proportion of requests containing a non-empty HTTP Referrer header.

SF_FILETYPE.label: Filetype Diversity Index
SF_FILETYPE.description: Ratio of distinct file extensions relative to unique visited pages.

MAX_BARRAGE.label: Maximum Barrage Burst
MAX_BARRAGE.description: Peak number of requests sent within any single 1-second interval.
